title: With icons-and-text task manager, a way to close all tasks when they're not grouped
line: When several windows of the same app sit ungrouped in the task manager, their context menu now has Close All to close them all at once.
explanation: The task manager's context menu only offers Close All on a group parent. With grouping off, or with Icons-and-Text's default 'only group when full' and enough room, each window of an app is its own task, so the menu only has Close and every window has to be closed one by one. The change adds a Close All item under Close for a top-level window task when other visible tasks belong to the same app (matched by app id or launcher URL, as grouping does); it closes all of them.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: offer Close All for ungrouped windows of an app

When several windows of the same app were shown as separate tasks, the
context menu only had Close, so they had to be closed one by one. Now a
Close All item closes every window of that app, like a grouped task does.

BUG: 485095
